facts.text: Terrebonne's Urbanova residential project will ultimately offer 12,000 housing units, including rentals, condominiums and single-family homes, and house 35,000 residents.
facts.evidence: The Urbanova residential project, which develops at the border of Bois-des-Filion, between the Mille-Îles River and Highway 640, will ultimately offer 12,000 housing units (rental, condominiums, and single-family homes) and house 35,000 residents.

facts.text: Terrebonne contains a hospital (Pierre-Le-Gardeur), a CEGEP (Cégep régional de Lanaudière à Terrebonne) and three university campuses.
facts.publisher: Ville de Terrebonne (pre-budget brief to the Quebec Ministère des Finances)
facts.evidence: The city of Terrebonne contains a hospital (Pierre-Le-Gardeur), a CEGEP (Cégep régional de Lanaudière à Terrebonne), and three university campuses.

facts.text: The MRC Les Moulins, which includes Terrebonne and Mascouche, has a population of 170,000 and is the 7th emerging economic development pole in Greater Montreal.
facts.evidence: The MRC Les Moulins (which includes Terrebonne and Mascouche) has a population of 170,000 ... The Les Moulins region represents the 7th emerging economic development pole in the Greater Montreal area.

facts.text: Vieux-Terrebonne is the heart of the city, with historic buildings at Île-des-Moulins, whose three mills were the economic heart of the city for decades.
facts.evidence: The Vieux-Terrebonne is the heart of the city with its historic buildings at Île-des-Moulins. Île-des-Moulins comprises three mills and was the economic heart of the city for decades.

facts.text: The governments of Canada and Quebec and the City of Terrebonne are building 100 affordable housing units for autonomous seniors, due for completion in spring 2026.
facts.evidence: The governments of Canada and Quebec, together with the organization Mission Unitaînés and the City of Terrebonne, announce the construction within the next two years of a building of 100 affordable housing units for autonomous seniors. The construction should be completed in the spring of 2026.

overview: Terrebonne counted 119,944 residents in the 2021 Census, a 7.5 percent increase since 2016, well ahead of the Quebec average. The median age was 40.8, and residents lived in 45,247 occupied dwellings spread over 153.76 square kilometres of suburban neighbourhoods on Montreal's North Shore.

Growth is driven by new housing, notably the Urbanova district, while a regional hospital, a CEGEP and university campuses anchor local employment. For a local business, that means a steady stream of new households choosing suppliers for the first time, and competition from Laval and Montreal brands for their attention.
